hero.title: Conquer the mountains. Return with stories.
hero.description: From glacier trails to summit sunrise climbs, Alpine Ascents designs unforgettable mountain journeys for explorers who want purpose, challenge, and breathtaking beauty in every step.

benefits.title: Expert-led treks
benefits.text: Every route is shaped by local guides who know the terrain, the weather, and the best places to pause for awe.

benefits.title: Comfort meets challenge
benefits.text: We blend rigorous adventure with thoughtful logistics, premium camps, and the right pace for your group.

benefits.title: Responsible travel
benefits.text: Our itineraries respect local communities, conservation zones, and the long-term health of the landscapes we love.

experiences.title: Summit coaching
experiences.description: Build endurance, master alpine skills, and gain confidence before tackling elevation with elite mountain mentorship.

experiences.title: Glacier expeditions
experiences.description: Step onto ice fields, traverse crevasses, and explore remote valleys with seasoned expedition leaders.

experiences.title: Private retreats
experiences.description: Enjoy custom itineraries for couples, families, and teams seeking a premium mountain escape.

testimonials.quote: Every detail felt considered. The guides were knowledgeable, calm, and incredibly inspiring from the first climb to the final summit toast.
testimonials.name: Emma Clarke

testimonials.quote: We booked a private retreat for our anniversary and it exceeded every expectation. The scenery was unreal and the service was flawless.
testimonials.name: Daniel & Sarah

testimonials.quote: Alpine Ascents made learning mountaineering feel safe, exciting, and deeply personal. It turned a bucket-list goal into a real achievement.
testimonials.name: Marcus Lee
